title: select_columns: keep only specified columns
description: Keep only the specified columns and drop all others. Useful for reducing the dataset to relevant fields before further analysis, or for producing a clean output. All column names in the list must exist in the dataset.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: List of column names to keep. All names must exist in the dataset. Every column not in this list will be dropped.

rag_note: Every column name in the list must exist in the dataset. The validator will reject unknown column names. If the user says 'show me region and sales only', this is the right step.
